blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createEntitiesStep` step. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

children.name: moduleRegistrationName
children.description: The regitration name of the module that contains the method to be invoked.

children.name: compensateMethod
children.description: The method to be invoked in case of compensation (when an error occurs).

children.name: entityIdentifier
children.description: A string to pass to the compensate method.

children.name: data
children.description:
The data to pass to the invoke method.
For example, an array of objects to create.
